intro: Travel breaks routines — airports, hotels, unfamiliar shops. Success means a lighter ritual you can keep, not a perfect home clone.
buddyTip: Pack a protein fallback (jerky, skyr, tuna pouches, protein yoghurt, nuts counted in advance) so delays don’t force chaos.
mission: For your next trip day, pre-write: breakfast default, protein fallback, and “log every meal same day.”
why: Travel weeks teach Buddy about your real life. Hiding them creates a false baseline. Logging on the road is a professional skill for long-term health.
Constraints change: mini-fridges, buffet breakfasts, client dinners, step counts from walking cities, sleep debt. Adjust expectations — keep capture.
Scale Health Success includes families on holiday. Shared simple defaults beat individual crash diets that ruin the trip.

points: Hotel breakfast: build a protein plate first
Steps often rise — still don’t treat wearable burn as unlimited free food
Hydration drops on planes — drink and log water
One flexible restaurant rule prevents all-or-nothing spirals

misconceptions.myth: Travel weeks don’t count — I’ll restart Monday at home.
misconceptions.truth: Life includes travel. Practise the light ritual now so Monday isn’t a myth.

misconceptions.myth: I must find a full kitchen or I’ve failed.
misconceptions.truth: Protein defaults + honest estimates + walking are enough for many trips.

how.lead: Prepare a travel card in your notes before you leave.
steps: List protein fallbacks that clear security / fit the destination
Identify a grocery near the hotel for yoghurt, fruit, cut veg
Set a logging alarm if time zones scramble evenings
Use voice logging when typing is awkward on trains
Keep weigh-ins optional if hotel scales are nonsense — resume at home
Weekly review after travel: what worked as a template next time?
how.buddyHelps: Voice and camera are travel-native. Home remains the desk even in another city. Progress will show the week without demanding perfection.

sections.title: Buffets and conferences
paras: One plate, protein and plants first, then a planned treat if you want it. Coffee breaks still count — log pastries.
Standing buffets encourage grazing; sit with a finished plate to create an end signal.

sections.title: Training on the road
paras: Short bodyweight or hotel-gym sessions maintain identity. Match carbs to what you actually do — not to the holiday fantasy workout.

mistakes.quote: I’ll remember everything and log when I’m home.
mistakes.why: You won’t. Portions and snacks vanish from memory. Log same day.

mistakes.quote: I walked 20k steps so calories didn’t matter.
mistakes.why: Steps help; liquid calories and restaurant oils still add up. Keep rough honesty.

mistakes.quote: I restricted hard in transit then overate at dinner.
mistakes.why: Fuel transit days moderately. Extreme saving backfires.

encouragement: A trip with imperfect logs still teaches Buddy. Bring the light ritual with you — that is Consistency over Intensity in motion.
